title: Puffin Ride
description: Puffin ride, as a puffin ride preset, is a commute on the wrong bird: a person mounted on a puffin against cliffs and spray, orange beak readable, played straight. A puffin next to a hiker is not the gag.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Gags and dream travel: documentary camera, cliffs, surf, a flying or perched seabird as engine. Dolphin ride stays in water.
Penguin ride stays on ice or city slush. Puffin ride can leave the water because the bird can fly, which is the extra joke if you still play it as a commute.
It is the wrong tool for wildlife films that respect puffin colonies, and the wrong tool if the bird is only in the background. Mounted.
Moving. Spray in the air.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Puffin Ride in film?
A straight-faced mount gag on a puffin, usually against cliffs and spray. The bird is the engine. A wildlife companion shot does not count.
Puffin Ride vs Penguin Ride
Penguin ride is ice or city, flightless. Puffin ride is cliffs and a flying seabird. Same postcard law, different geography and animal.
When should I use Puffin Ride?
Gags and dream cliff commutes. Skip respectful puffin documentaries.
How do I prompt Puffin Ride for AI image or video?

Cliffs, mounted [Subject], then: Puffin-ride of [Subject], an absurd seabird mount, cliffs and spray, a commute on the wrong bird. Video: [Subject] rides a puffin against cliffs or surf. Face committed.
